Stephanie Zhang: for the OpaqueRange HTML PR I posted AI-generated feedback which looked accurate to me. I also left some suggestions on the DOM PR. I think we probably want to refactor a bit more so we don't need "live range and opaque range" changes everywhere; I can work on that.

It also seems like the CSSOM and Highlights API changes are not yet up-to-date? They still talk about associated elements and such...
